-- One substantive integration scenario per mode/speed, under explicit waypoints.
local function vec(v)return string.format("%.9f,%.9f,%.9f",v.X,v.Y,v.Z)end
local scenes=workspace:FindFirstChild("EGGRUMBLE_LOBBY_CASTLE_MODES_PREVIEW")
local started=nil
local function milestone(name,detail)print("MILESTONE\t"..name.."\t"..detail)end
local function scenario()
 advanceTo(now)
 firePrompt(scenes.ROLE_WARRIOR,"職業選択",player)
 firePrompt(scenes:FindFirstChild(TEST_MODE.."_PORTAL"),"参加する",player)
 advanceTo(now+12.01)
 assertCheck(#capturedSessions==1,"one actual Host round")
 routeSession=capturedSessions[1]
 local s=routeSession
 assertCheck(s.mode==TEST_MODE and s.rules.phase=="ACTIVE","actual mode running")
 local botId=if TEST_MODE=="TEAM"then"AI_2"else"AI_1"
 local bot=s.botActors[botId]
 assertCheck(bot and bot.Parent,"actual BotActors spawn exists")
 local home=s.castleLocations[botId]
 local initial=bot:GetPivot().Position
 assertCheck((initial-(home+V.new(0,1.5,-34))).Magnitude<1e-8,"unaltered actual spawn position")
 assertCheck(bot.PrimaryPart.Size==V.new(2.1,3.2,1.6),"actual source root dimensions")
 local bits=s.castleModels[botId]
 local ramp=bits.model:FindFirstChild("CastleAccessRamp")
 assertCheck(ramp.CFrame.UpVector.Z<-.2 and ramp.CFrame.UpVector.Y>.97,"real Host ramp rotation preserved, never identity")
 assertCheck(ramp.Size==V.new(11,.8,20)and ramp.CanCollide,"actual rotated source ramp")
 assertCheck(bits.model.StandardFoundation.CanCollide and not bits.door.CanCollide,"actual solid foundation/open gate")
 milestone("ACTUAL_SPAWN",vec(initial).." rampUp="..vec(ramp.CFrame.UpVector))

 -- Consume field alternatives through actual existing human prompt/Rules paths.
 -- This isolates a vault raid without rewriting the BotActors objective logic.
 local humanFieldPickups=0
 for i=1,24 do
  local field=s.world:FindFirstChild("FieldEgg_"..i)
  if field then
   firePrompt(field,"卵を拾う",player)
   humanFieldPickups+=1
  end
  assertCheck(s.rules.fieldEggTokens["FIELD_"..i]==nil or s.rules.fieldEggTokens["FIELD_"..i]==false,"field token truly spent")
  if i%3==0 then
   firePrompt(s.castleModels[tostring(player.UserId)].model.OwnEggDeposit,"卵を納入",player)
   assertCheck(s.rules.castles[tostring(player.UserId)].heldEggs==0,"actual human deposit drains cargo")
   advanceTo(now+.91)
  end
 end
 milestone("FIELD_SETUP","humanPromptPickups="..humanFieldPickups.." alreadySpentBySourceBots="..(24-humanFieldPickups))
 assertCheck(Rules.auditEggConservation(s.rules).valid,"source inventory conserved after real setup")
 player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame=F.new(0,7,0)
 if TEST_SLOW then bot:SetAttribute("EGGRUMBLE_SlowUntil",now+1000)end
 focusId=botId
 started=now
 local exited=false;local stolen=false;local deposited=false
 local lastMoved=now;local previous=initial
 local originalVault=s.rules.castles[botId].vaultEggs
 for step=1,1600 do
  advanceTo(now+.18)
  local at=bot:GetPivot().Position
  if (at-previous).Magnitude>1e-6 then lastMoved=now;previous=at end
  if not exited and at.Z<home.Z-57 then
   exited=true;milestone("LEFT_OWN_CASTLE",vec(at).." after="..(now-started))
  end
  for _,event in ipairs(actionEvents)do
   if event.kind=="STEAL"and not stolen then
    stolen=true
    assertCheck(exited,"own real ramp egress precedes raid")
    assertCheck(planarDistance(event.position,event.target)<=12.5+1e-8,"actual vault action distance")
    assertCheck(math.abs(event.position.Y-event.target.Y)<=4+1e-8,"actual vault action height")
    assertCheck(event.actualPart and event.actualPart.Parent,"original actual vault Part")
    local q=RaycastParams.new();q.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    q.FilterDescendantsInstances={bot,bot.Parent};q.RespectCanCollide=true
    local from=event.position+V.new(0,.4,0)
    local hit=workspace:Raycast(from,event.target-from,q)
    assertCheck(hit==nil or hit.Instance==event.actualPart,"actual geometry permits vault LOS")
    milestone("VAULT_STOLEN",event.from.." at="..vec(event.position).." distance="..planarDistance(event.position,event.target))
   end
   if event.kind=="DEPOSIT"and not deposited then
    deposited=true
    assertCheck(stolen,"original theft precedes original return deposit")
    assertCheck(planarDistance(event.position,event.target)<=12.5+1e-8,"actual own deposit distance")
    assertCheck(math.abs(event.position.Y-event.target.Y)<=4+1e-8,"actual own deposit height")
    assertCheck(event.actualPart==bits.model.OwnEggDeposit,"actual owner deposit object")
    local q=RaycastParams.new();q.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    q.FilterDescendantsInstances={bot,bot.Parent};q.RespectCanCollide=true
    local from=event.position+V.new(0,.4,0)
    local hit=workspace:Raycast(from,event.target-from,q)
    assertCheck(hit==nil or hit.Instance==event.actualPart,"actual geometry permits own deposit LOS")
    milestone("HOME_DEPOSITED",vec(event.position).." distance="..planarDistance(event.position,event.target))
   end
  end
  if deposited then break end
  assertCheck(now-lastMoved<22,"focused bot stalled >22 simulated seconds with successful explicit waypoint service at="..vec(at).." goal="..s.botObjectives[botId])
 end
 assertCheck(exited and stolen and deposited,"bounded actual spawn->vault->home loop completed")
 assertCheck(s.rules.castles[botId].heldEggs==0 and s.rules.castles[botId].vaultEggs==originalVault+1,"real Rules transfer deposited exactly stolen1")
 assertCheck(Rules.auditEggConservation(s.rules).valid,"actual whole-match conservation after raid")
 assertCheck(#pathCalls>0 and #routeMoves>0,"real Router accepted supplied path requests")
 local expectedDT=.18*(if TEST_SLOW then .45 else 1)
 for _,move in ipairs(routeMoves)do
  assertCheck(math.abs(move.dt-expectedDT)<1e-9,"original BotActors slow multiplier reaches Router")
  assertCheck(planarDistance(move.before,move.after)<=30*expectedDT+1e-6,"fixture pivot equals bounded source movement")
 end
 milestone("FINISHED_LOOP","simulatedSeconds="..(now-started).." routeTicks="..#routeMoves.." paths="..#pathCalls)
 focusId=nil
 Players.PlayerRemoving:Fire(player);player.Parent=nil;currentPlayers={}
 advanceTo(now+2)
 assertCheck(s.rules.phase=="ABANDONED"and s.world.Parent==nil and #pending==0,"real last-human cleanup and route retirement")
 return "actual whole Host/BotActors/Router; true ramp rotation; supplied paths; spawn/steal/deposit; "..TEST_MODE.." slow="..tostring(TEST_SLOW)
end
local ok,detail=pcall(scenario)
print("CASE\t"..TEST_MODE..(if TEST_SLOW then"_slow"else"_normal").."\t"..(if ok then"PASS"else"FAIL").."\t"..tostring(detail):gsub("\n"," "))
if not ok and routeSession and routeSession.rules.phase=="ACTIVE"then
 print("METRIC\tpending_at_failed_scenario_end\t"..#pending)
 focusId=nil
 Players.PlayerRemoving:Fire(player);player.Parent=nil;currentPlayers={}
 advanceTo(now+2)
end
for i,m in ipairs(routeMoves)do
 print("MOVE\t"..i.."\t"..m.at.."\t"..vec(m.before).."\t"..vec(m.after).."\t"..vec(m.goal).."\t"..m.dt.."\t"..m.held)
end
for i,p in ipairs(pathCalls)do
 local values={};for _,point in ipairs(p.points)do table.insert(values,vec(point.Position))end
 print("PATH\t"..i.."\t"..p.at.."\t"..table.concat(values,";"))
end
for name,n in pairs(queryStats)do print("METRIC\tquery_"..name.."\t"..n)end
for name,n in pairs(queryHits)do print("HIT\t"..name.."\t"..n)end
print("METRIC\tstationary_other_router_calls\t"..ignoredRouterCalls)
print("METRIC\tfocused_router_calls\t"..#routeMoves)
print("METRIC\tprovided_paths\t"..#pathCalls)
finishEvidence()
if not ok then error(detail,0)end

-- Focus movement is frozen for decision tables; no synthetic private helper.
local failures=0
local function contract(name,fn)
 local ok,detail=pcall(fn)
 print("CASE\t"..name.."\t"..(if ok then"PASS"else"FAIL").."\t"..tostring(detail or ""):gsub("\n"," "))
 if not ok then failures+=1 end
end
local function same(a,b)return(a-b).Magnitude<1e-7 end
local function vec(v)return string.format("%.6f,%.6f,%.6f",v.X,v.Y,v.Z)end
local scenes=workspace:FindFirstChild("EGGRUMBLE_LOBBY_CASTLE_MODES_PREVIEW")
advanceTo(now)
firePrompt(scenes.ROLE_WARRIOR,"職業選択",player)
firePrompt(scenes.TEAM_PORTAL,"参加する",player)
advanceTo(now+12.01)
routeSession=capturedSessions[1]
local s=routeSession
assertCheck(s and s.mode=="TEAM"and s.rules.phase=="ACTIVE","actual TEAM Host round")
local reserved=s.world:FindFirstChild("FieldEgg_24")
assertCheck(reserved and s.rules.fieldEggTokens.FIELD_24==true,"one original field token reserved")
local function depositHuman()
 local human=s.rules.castles[tostring(player.UserId)]
 if human.heldEggs>0 then
  firePrompt(s.castleModels[tostring(player.UserId)].model.OwnEggDeposit,"卵を納入",player)
  assertCheck(human.heldEggs==0,"original human deposit")
  advanceTo(now+.91)
 end
end
for i=1,23 do
 local egg=s.world:FindFirstChild("FieldEgg_"..i)
 if egg then firePrompt(egg,"卵を拾う",player)end
 if s.rules.castles[tostring(player.UserId)].heldEggs==3 then depositHuman()end
end
depositHuman()
player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame=F.new(0,7,0)
focusId="AI_2";freezeFocusedMovement=true
local bot=s.botActors[focusId]
local enemyId="AI_1";local enemyLoc=s.castleLocations[enemyId]
local front=enemyLoc+V.new(0,3,-26);local inner=enemyLoc+V.new(0,3,-2)
local function decision(dx,dz,field)
 -- Elevated avatar is a deliberate position input to prevent physical actions
 -- while inspecting planar source goal/field decisions. Not a walkability test.
 local at=enemyLoc+V.new(dx,20,dz)
 bot:PivotTo(F.new(at))
 reserved.Position=if field then at+V.new(30,0,0)else V.new(10000,10000,10000)
 local before=#routeMoves
 advanceTo(now+.181)
 assertCheck(#routeMoves>before,"actual source BotActors tick requested a goal")
 assertCheck(s.rules.castles[focusId].heldEggs==0,"geometric decision probe grants no eggs")
 local goal=routeMoves[#routeMoves].goal
 print("DECISION\t"..dx.."\t"..dz.."\t"..tostring(field).."\t"..s.botObjectives[focusId].."\t"..vec(goal))
 return goal
end

contract("field_priority_unchanged_at_front_progress_side_and_rear",function()
 local cases={
  {0,-50,true},{0,-26,false},{0,-8,true},{0,-7,true},
  {17,-10,true},{19,-10,true},{5,-10,false},
  {0,-1,true},{0,8,true},{0,20,true},
 }
 for _,row in ipairs(cases)do
  local goal=decision(row[1],row[2],true)
  local expect=if row[3]then reserved.Position else inner
  assertCheck(same(goal,expect),"field priority changed at "..row[1]..","..row[2])
 end
 return "10 declared front/progression/side/rear positions; same original field preference; no inventory mutation"
end)

contract("raid_goal_uses_bounded_forward_strip_without_rear_extension",function()
 local cases={
  {0,-44,false},{0,-43.9,true},{0,-26,true},{0,-8,true},{0,-7,true},
  {0,-2,true},{0,-1,false},{0,8,false},{0,20,false},
  {17.9,-4,true},{18,-4,false},{-17.9,-4,true},{-18,-4,false},
 }
 local mismatch={}
 for _,row in ipairs(cases)do
  local goal=decision(row[1],row[2],false)
  local expect=if row[3]then inner else front
  if not same(goal,expect)then table.insert(mismatch,row[1]..","..row[2])end
 end
 assertCheck(#mismatch==0,"raid goal contract mismatches: "..table.concat(mismatch,";"))
 return "13 boundary/side/rear positions; front and inner goals unchanged; no admission beyond existing inner goal"
end)

contract("real_bot_death_respawn_recomputes_goal_and_clears_router",function()
 decision(0,-7,false)
 local old=bot
 local beforeClears=#clearEvents
 old:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"):TakeDamage(100)
 advanceTo(now+6.5)
 bot=s.botActors[focusId]
 assertCheck(bot~=old and old.Parent==nil and bot.Parent~=nil,"actual source actor replacement")
 assertCheck(same(bot:GetPivot().Position,s.castleLocations[focusId]+V.new(0,1.5,-34)),"actual fresh spawn, no stale entered position")
 local found=false
 for i=beforeClears+1,#clearEvents do if clearEvents[i].id==s.mode..":"..focusId then found=true end end
 assertCheck(found,"original BotActors called actual Router.clear before replacement")
 assertCheck(same(routeMoves[#routeMoves].goal,front),"new actor requests front from actual home, not old inner goal")
 assertCheck(Rules.auditEggConservation(s.rules).valid,"death and replacement conserve stock")
 return "actual death -> six-second source rebirth -> new Model/source spawn; Router clear observed; goal recomputed"
end)

contract("missing_vault_and_real_castle_fall_cannot_retain_old_target",function()
 reserved.Position=V.new(10000,10000,10000)
 local victim=s.rules.castles[enemyId]
 local vault=s.castleModels[enemyId].model.EggVault
 local oldVault=victim.vaultEggs
 vault:Destroy()
 bot:PivotTo(F.new(enemyLoc+V.new(0,1.5,-5)))
 advanceTo(now+.181)
 assertCheck(victim.vaultEggs==oldVault and s.rules.castles[focusId].heldEggs==0,"missing actual vault cannot transfer eggs")
 -- Move only the decision probe out of physical combat; destroy the target
 -- through actual paced human siege callbacks, not an edited alive/HP field.
 bot:PivotTo(F.new(enemyLoc+V.new(0,20,-7)))
 local hits=0
 while victim.alive and hits<30 do
  firePrompt(s.castleModels[enemyId].door,"攻城攻撃",player)
  hits+=1;advanceTo(now+3)
 end
 assertCheck(not victim.alive and s.rules.phase=="ACTIVE","real target falls while other enemies keep round active")
 -- Consume newly released original tokens so they do not preempt this target
 -- decision. No field authority is replaced by the observer.
 for _,item in ipairs(s.world:GetChildren())do
  if item:IsA("BasePart")and item.Name:match("^ReleasedEgg_")then
   firePrompt(item,"拾う",player)
   if s.rules.castles[tostring(player.UserId)].heldEggs==3 then depositHuman()end
  end
 end
 depositHuman();player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame=F.new(0,7,0)
 advanceTo(now+.181)
 local goal=routeMoves[#routeMoves].goal
 assertCheck(not same(goal,front)and not same(goal,inner),"eliminated enemy has no old front/inner target authority")
 local valid=false
 for id,c in pairs(s.rules.castles)do
  if id~=focusId and c.alive and c.team~=s.rules.castles[focusId].team then
   local loc=s.castleLocations[id]
   if same(goal,loc+V.new(0,3,-26))or same(goal,loc+V.new(0,3,-2))then valid=true end
  end
 end
 assertCheck(valid and s.botObjectives[focusId]=="STEAL","source desiredTarget chose a different living enemy")
 assertCheck(Rules.auditEggConservation(s.rules).valid,"source castle fall/released pickup conserve stock")
 print("TARGET_CHANGED\t"..enemyId.."\t"..vec(goal).."\t"..hits)
 return "missing Part blocks action; real paced siege eliminates old target; current source target recomputed without a stale latch"
end)

contract("last_human_leave_retires_source_loop_and_route",function()
 local before=#clearEvents
 Players.PlayerRemoving:Fire(player);player.Parent=nil;currentPlayers={}
 advanceTo(now+2)
 assertCheck(s.rules.phase=="ABANDONED"and s.world.Parent==nil and #pending==0,"original last-human close retires round")
 local found=false
 for i=before+1,#clearEvents do if clearEvents[i].id==s.mode..":"..focusId then found=true end end
 assertCheck(found,"source bot loop clears focused Router on shutdown")
 local calls=#routeMoves
 advanceTo(now+5)
 assertCheck(#routeMoves==calls,"no stale source goal after round retirement")
 return "actual close and source-loop Router.clear; no new private phase state or late navigation"
end)
print("METRIC\tdecision_and_lifecycle_route_calls\t"..#routeMoves)
print("METRIC\trouter_clear_calls\t"..#clearEvents)
finishEvidence()
if failures>0 then error("contract failures="..failures,0)end

-- New fixture-only controls around the existing complete Host/Bot/Rules bodies.
-- Poses and service timing are explicit inputs. They are not engine play evidence.
local contractChecks={}
local damageObservations={}
local fixtureDamage=methods.TakeDamage
function methods:TakeDamage(amount)
 local _,line=debug.info(2,"sl")
 local row={at=now,target=self.Parent and self.Parent.Name or "none",amount=amount,
  before=self.Health,sourceLine=line}
 table.insert(damageObservations,row)
 fixtureDamage(self,amount)
 row.after=self.Health
end
local function check(name,value,detail)
 table.insert(contractChecks,{name=name,pass=value,detail=tostring(detail)})
 print("CHECK\t"..name.."\t"..(if value then "PASS" else "FAIL").."\t"..tostring(detail))
end
local function makeHuman(name,id)
 local p=Instance.new("Player");p.Name=name;p.UserId=id;p.Parent=Players
 local gui=Instance.new("PlayerGui");gui.Parent=p
 local backpack=Instance.new("Backpack");backpack.Parent=p
 local ch=Instance.new("Model");ch.Name=name.."Avatar";ch.Parent=workspace
 local h=Instance.new("Humanoid");h.Parent=ch
 local r=Instance.new("Part");r.Name="HumanoidRootPart";r.Parent=ch
 r.CFrame=F.new(0,7,10)
 ch.PrimaryPart=r;p.Character=ch
 table.insert(currentPlayers,p)
 Players.PlayerAdded:Fire(p)
 return p,h,r
end
local function leave(p)
 if p.Parent==Players then
  Players.PlayerRemoving:Fire(p)
  p.Parent=nil
  for i=#currentPlayers,1,-1 do if currentPlayers[i]==p then table.remove(currentPlayers,i)end end
 end
end
local function parkHumans()
 for i,p in ipairs(currentPlayers)do
  if p.Character then p.Character:PivotTo(F.new(0,7,10*i))end
 end
end
local function parkBots(s)
 for id,b in pairs(s.botActors)do
  if b.Parent then b:PivotTo(F.new(s.castleLocations[id]+V.new(0,1.5,-34)))end
 end
end
local function bootstrap(mode,people)
 advanceTo(now)
 local scenes=workspace:FindFirstChild("EGGRUMBLE_LOBBY_CASTLE_MODES_PREVIEW")
 for _,p in ipairs(people)do
  firePrompt(scenes.ROLE_WARRIOR,"職業選択",p)
  firePrompt(scenes:FindFirstChild(mode.."_PORTAL"),"参加する",p)
 end
 advanceTo(now+12.01)
 local s=nil
 for _,session in ipairs(capturedSessions)do
  if session.mode==mode and session.rules.phase=="ACTIVE"then s=session end
 end
 assertCheck(s~=nil,"actual full Host started requested mode")
 assertCheck(stubCalls["BotActors.start"]==nil,"actual BotActors replaced the existing stub")
 assertCheck(stubCalls["Invul.attach"]==nil,"actual InvulRuntime replaced the existing stub")
 routeSession=s;freezeFocusedMovement=true
 parkHumans();parkBots(s)
 advanceTo(now+4.1)
 return s
end
local function stage(s,botId)
 routeSession=s;focusId=botId;freezeFocusedMovement=true
 parkHumans();parkBots(s)
 advanceTo(now+1.3)
 local field=s.world:FindFirstChild("TacticalBattlefield")
 assertCheck(field~=nil,"actual Host battlefield exists")
 local at=field.Position+V.new(70,5,80)
 s.botActors[botId]:PivotTo(F.new(at))
 return at
end
local function tick()advanceTo(now+.181)end
local function finalize(name,scenario)
 local ok,detail=pcall(scenario)
 focusId=nil
 for _,p in ipairs(table.clone(currentPlayers))do leave(p)end
 local cleanupOk,cleanupError=pcall(function()advanceTo(now+8)end)
 check("all_original_host_tasks_retired",cleanupOk and #pending==0,cleanupError or #pending)
 check("no_swallowed_runtime_warnings",#warnings==0,#warnings)
 local accepted=ok and cleanupOk
 for _,row in ipairs(contractChecks)do accepted=accepted and row.pass end
 print("CASE\t"..name.."\t"..(if accepted then "PASS"else "FAIL").."\t"..tostring(detail or ""):gsub("\n"," "))
 print("METRIC\tcontract_checks\t"..#contractChecks)
 print("METRIC\tpending_after_cleanup\t"..#pending)
 print("METRIC\tfocused_decisions\t"..#routeMoves)
 for i,row in ipairs(damageObservations)do
  print("DAMAGE\t"..i.."\t"..row.at.."\t"..row.target.."\t"..row.amount.."\t"..row.before.."\t"..row.after.."\t"..row.sourceLine)
 end
 for _,warning in ipairs(warnings)do print("WARNING\t"..warning)end
 if not accepted then error(detail or "one or more substantive contract checks failed",0)end
end

-- Root poses deliberately isolate eligibility; Router movement is frozen.
finalize("FORMAL_BOT_CURRENT_HUMAN_AND_AI_TARGETS",function()
 local second,secondHumanoid=makeHuman("BotTargetPeer",43)
 local s=bootstrap("TEAM",{player,second})
 assertCheck(s.isCurrentHuman(player) and s.isCurrentHuman(second),"both actual current humans")
 local home=s.rules.castles[tostring(player.UserId)]
 local other=s.rules.castles[tostring(second.UserId)]
 assertCheck(home.team~=other.team,"actual balanced TEAM roster gives opposing human teams")
 local botId=nil;local enemyBotId=nil;local allyBotId=nil
 for id,b in pairs(s.botActors)do
  local c=s.rules.castles[id]
  if c.team==home.team then
   if not botId then botId=id elseif not allyBotId then allyBotId=id end
  elseif not enemyBotId then enemyBotId=id end
 end
 assertCheck(botId and enemyBotId and allyBotId,"source spawned both allied and enemy AI")
 local bot=s.botActors[botId]
 local enemyBot=s.botActors[enemyBotId]
 local enemyHum=enemyBot:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 local allyBot=s.botActors[allyBotId]
 local allyHum=allyBot:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 local at=stage(s,botId)
 player.Character:PivotTo(F.new(at+V.new(0,0,3)))
 second.Character:PivotTo(F.new(at+V.new(0,0,7)))
 local friendBefore,enemyBefore=humanoid.Health,secondHumanoid.Health
 tick()
 check("nearer_allied_human_is_skipped",humanoid.Health==friendBefore,humanoid.Health-friendBefore)
 check("living_current_enemy_human_receives_one_real_hit",secondHumanoid.Health==enemyBefore-13,enemyBefore-secondHumanoid.Health)
 local cooldownHP=secondHumanoid.Health
 advanceTo(now+.36)
 check("shared_melee_cooldown_blocks_repeat",secondHumanoid.Health==cooldownHP,cooldownHP-secondHumanoid.Health)

 at=stage(s,botId)
 second.Character:PivotTo(F.new(at+V.new(0,0,6)))
 local wall=Instance.new("Part");wall.Name="BotMeleeCoverInput";wall.Size=V.new(8,9,.5)
 wall.CFrame=F.new(at+V.new(0,2,3));wall.CanCollide=true;wall.Parent=s.world
 enemyBefore=secondHumanoid.Health
 tick()

-- Contract: only an actual nearby unblocked live objective can transfer an egg.
-- Token pickup, deposit, theft, death drop and rebirth remain actual Host/Rules.
-- Explicit bot poses isolate action boundaries; they do not prove route traversal.
finalize("FORMAL_BOT_EGG_CUSTODY_AND_DEATH",function()
 local s=bootstrap("TEAM",{player})
 local botId="AI_2";local enemyId="AI_1"
 local bot=s.botActors[botId];local me=s.rules.castles[botId]
 local enemy=s.rules.castles[enemyId]
 assertCheck(bot and enemy and me.team~=enemy.team,"actual opposed castle pair")
 local reserved=s.world:FindFirstChild("FieldEgg_24")
 assertCheck(reserved and s.rules.fieldEggTokens.FIELD_24==true,"reserve an existing world field token")
 local function depositHuman()
  local state=s.rules.castles[tostring(player.UserId)]
  if state.heldEggs>0 then
   firePrompt(s.castleModels[state.id].model.OwnEggDeposit,"卵を納入",player)
   assertCheck(state.heldEggs==0,"actual setup human deposit")
   parkHumans();advanceTo(now+.91)
  end
 end
 for i=1,23 do
  local egg=s.world:FindFirstChild("FieldEgg_"..i)
  if egg then firePrompt(egg,"卵を拾う",player)end
  if s.rules.castles[tostring(player.UserId)].heldEggs==3 then depositHuman()end
 end
 depositHuman();parkHumans()
 routeSession=s;focusId=botId;freezeFocusedMovement=true
 assertCheck(me.heldEggs==0,"focused bot begins empty under actual source")
 local fieldAt=reserved.Position
 bot:PivotTo(F.new(fieldAt+V.new(12.51,0,0)));tick()
 check("field_pickup_outside_action_radius_rejected",me.heldEggs==0 and s.rules.fieldEggTokens.FIELD_24==true,s.botObjectives[botId])
 bot:PivotTo(F.new(fieldAt+V.new(0,0,6)))
 local wall=Instance.new("Part");wall.Name="BotEggCoverInput";wall.Size=V.new(8,9,.5)
 wall.CFrame=F.new(fieldAt+V.new(0,2,3));wall.CanCollide=true;wall.Parent=s.world
 tick()
 check("field_pickup_through_wall_rejected",me.heldEggs==0 and s.rules.fieldEggTokens.FIELD_24==true,me.heldEggs)
 wall:Destroy()
 bot:PivotTo(F.new(fieldAt+V.new(0,4.01,0)));tick()
 check("field_pickup_above_height_limit_rejected",me.heldEggs==0 and s.rules.fieldEggTokens.FIELD_24==true,me.heldEggs)
 bot:PivotTo(F.new(fieldAt+V.new(0,0,3)));tick()
 check("one_real_field_token_enters_bot_custody",me.heldEggs==1 and s.rules.fieldEggTokens.FIELD_24~=true and reserved.Parent==nil,
  "held="..me.heldEggs..", token="..tostring(s.rules.fieldEggTokens.FIELD_24))
 assertCheck(me.heldEggs==1,"positive field pickup required before return tests")
 check("field_pickup_preserves_whole_match_stock",Rules.auditEggConservation(s.rules).valid,"actual Rules audit")

 local deposit=s.castleLocations[botId]+V.new(-16,3,-18)
 local homeStock=me.vaultEggs
 bot:PivotTo(F.new(deposit+V.new(12.51,0,0)));tick()
 check("distant_own_deposit_rejected",me.heldEggs==1 and me.vaultEggs==homeStock,me.heldEggs)
 bot:PivotTo(F.new(deposit+V.new(0,0,-6)))
 wall=Instance.new("Part");wall.Name="BotDepositCoverInput";wall.Size=V.new(8,9,.5)
 wall.CFrame=F.new(deposit+V.new(0,2,-3));wall.CanCollide=true;wall.Parent=s.world
 tick()
 check("own_deposit_through_wall_rejected",me.heldEggs==1 and me.vaultEggs==homeStock,me.heldEggs)
 wall:Destroy()
 bot:PivotTo(F.new(deposit+V.new(0,0,-3)));tick()
 check("real_return_priority_deposits_exact_one",s.botObjectives[botId]=="RETURN" and me.heldEggs==0 and me.vaultEggs==homeStock+1,
  "held="..me.heldEggs..", vaultDelta="..(me.vaultEggs-homeStock))
 assertCheck(me.heldEggs==0,"positive own deposit required before theft")

 local vault=s.castleModels[enemyId].model.EggVault
 local vaultParent=vault.Parent
 local target=s.castleLocations[enemyId]+V.new(0,3,6)
 local vaultStock=enemy.vaultEggs
 bot:PivotTo(F.new(target+V.new(0,0,-12.51)));tick()
 check("distant_enemy_vault_rejected",me.heldEggs==0 and enemy.vaultEggs==vaultStock,me.heldEggs)
 bot:PivotTo(F.new(target+V.new(0,0,-11)))
 vault.Parent=nil;tick()
 check("missing_live_vault_rejected",me.heldEggs==0 and enemy.vaultEggs==vaultStock,me.heldEggs)
 vault.Parent=vaultParent
 wall=Instance.new("Part");wall.Name="BotVaultCoverInput";wall.Size=V.new(8,9,.5)
 wall.CFrame=F.new(target+V.new(0,2,-5));wall.CanCollide=true;wall.Parent=s.world
 tick()
 check("enemy_vault_through_wall_rejected",me.heldEggs==0 and enemy.vaultEggs==vaultStock,me.heldEggs)
 wall:Destroy();tick()
 check("real_vault_transfer_moves_exact_one_egg",me.heldEggs==1 and enemy.vaultEggs==vaultStock-1,
  "held="..me.heldEggs..", vaultDelta="..(enemy.vaultEggs-vaultStock))
 assertCheck(me.heldEggs==1,"source theft required before death custody test")
 check("theft_preserves_whole_match_stock",Rules.auditEggConservation(s.rules).valid,"actual Rules audit")

 local tokensBefore={}
 for id,active in pairs(s.rules.fieldEggTokens)do if active then tokensBefore[id]=true end end
 local old=bot;local oldHum=old:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 local clearBefore=#clearEvents
 oldHum:TakeDamage(oldHum.Health);tick()
 local dropped={}
 for id,active in pairs(s.rules.fieldEggTokens)do
  if active and not tokensBefore[id]then table.insert(dropped,id)end
 end
 check("death_drops_one_actual_carried_token",me.heldEggs==0 and #dropped==1,
  "held="..me.heldEggs..", newTokens="..#dropped)
 if #dropped==1 then
  local part=s.world:FindFirstChild("ReleasedEgg_"..dropped[1])
  check("death_drop_has_real_world_part",part~=nil and part.Parent==s.world,dropped[1])
 end
 advanceTo(now+6.3)
 bot=s.botActors[botId]
 check("source_rebirth_replaces_dead_model",bot~=old and old.Parent==nil and bot.Parent~=nil,
  "replaced="..tostring(bot~=old))
 local sawClear=false
 for i=clearBefore+1,#clearEvents do if clearEvents[i].id=="TEAM:"..botId then sawClear=true end end
 check("source_rebirth_clears_old_router",sawClear,#clearEvents-clearBefore)
 local activeDrops=0
 for _,id in ipairs(dropped)do if s.rules.fieldEggTokens[id]==true then activeDrops+=1 end end
 check("death_does_not_duplicate_or_retain_carried_egg",me.heldEggs==0 and activeDrops==1 and Rules.auditEggConservation(s.rules).valid,
  "held="..me.heldEggs..", activeDropTokens="..activeDrops)
 return "actual field/vault/own-deposit Rules transitions and Host death-drop; original distance, height, LOS and rebirth guards"
end)

-- Contract: actual concurrent TEAM/BR sessions never grant target membership
-- across modes; retiring TEAM does not retire BR or create late takeover AI.
-- Posed actors isolate membership. Shared Router callback ownership is tested
-- separately with the real Router and an explicitly yielding path service.
finalize("FORMAL_BOT_CONCURRENT_MODE_AND_RETIREMENT",function()
 local peer,peerHum=makeHuman("ParallelBRHuman",43)
 local team=bootstrap("TEAM",{player})
 local br=bootstrap("BATTLE_ROYALE",{peer})
 assertCheck(#capturedSessions==2,"two actual Host sessions")
 assertCheck(team.isCurrentHuman(player) and not team.isCurrentHuman(peer),"TEAM membership from Host")
 assertCheck(br.isCurrentHuman(peer) and not br.isCurrentHuman(player),"BR membership from Host")
 local teamId="AI_1";local brId="AI_1"
 local teamBot=team.botActors[teamId];local brBot=br.botActors[brId]
 assertCheck(teamBot and brBot and teamBot~=brBot,"same roster id has distinct mode actor instances")
 local at=stage(team,teamId)
 peer.Character:PivotTo(F.new(at+V.new(0,0,6)))
 local before=peerHum.Health;tick()
 check("TEAM_bot_rejects_live_BR_human_at_melee_range",peerHum.Health==before,before-peerHum.Health)

 parkBots(team)
 at=stage(br,brId)
 player.Character:PivotTo(F.new(at+V.new(0,0,6)))
 before=humanoid.Health;tick()
 check("BR_bot_rejects_live_TEAM_human_at_melee_range",humanoid.Health==before,before-humanoid.Health)
 at=stage(br,brId)
 peer.Character:PivotTo(F.new(at+V.new(0,0,6)))
 before=peerHum.Health;tick()
 check("BR_bot_accepts_its_current_enemy_human",peerHum.Health==before-13,before-peerHum.Health)
 parkHumans();parkBots(team);parkBots(br)

 routeSession=br;focusId=brId;freezeFocusedMovement=true
 local clearBefore=#clearEvents;local brDecisions=#routeMoves
 leave(player);advanceTo(now+2)
 check("last_TEAM_human_departure_retires_TEAM_only",team.rules.phase=="ABANDONED" and team.world.Parent==nil
  and br.rules.phase=="ACTIVE" and br.world.Parent~=nil,"TEAM="..team.rules.phase..", BR="..br.rules.phase)
 local teamClears,brClears=0,0
 for i=clearBefore+1,#clearEvents do
  if clearEvents[i].id:sub(1,5)=="TEAM:"then teamClears+=1 end
  if clearEvents[i].id:sub(1,13)=="BATTLE_ROYALE:"then brClears+=1 end
 end
 check("retiring_TEAM_clears_only_TEAM_router_keys",teamClears>0 and brClears==0,
  "TEAM="..teamClears..", BR="..brClears)
 check("BR_source_loop_continues_after_TEAM_retirement",#routeMoves>brDecisions,#routeMoves-brDecisions)
 local actorCount=0
 for _ in pairs(team.botActors)do actorCount+=1 end
 local result=team.takeover(tostring(player.UserId))
 local afterCount=0
 for _ in pairs(team.botActors)do afterCount+=1 end
 check("retired_TEAM_rejects_late_takeover",result==false and afterCount==actorCount,tostring(result))
 check("both_original_rule_ledgers_conserved",Rules.auditEggConservation(team.rules).valid and Rules.auditEggConservation(br.rules).valid,
  "distinct actual session ledgers")
 return "two real Host modes, same AI id with distinct models, cross-mode human rejection, live BR continuation and terminal takeover fence"
end)
